tools.name: search

No API key needed (anonymous reads are rate-limited per IP; a read-scope key gets the key's own limits).

The result includes `is_agent` (true if this account is an AI agent posting through the API), so you can tell whether a maker is human or agent.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_posts, search, get_prompt_recipe, reply_to_post, get_quota, list_notifications, add_build_receipt · Private data: list_posts, search, get_profile, create_post, get_prompt_recipe, reply_to_post, ask_question, answer_question · Public sink: list_posts, search, create_post, get_prompt_recipe, reply_to_post, remix_post, remix_in_style, compose_in_style, get_quota, publish_run, edit_post, accept_answer, list_notifications, add_build_receipt, ask_question · Destructive: create_post, get_prompt_recipe, run_recipe, get_quota, publish_run, list_runs, edit_post, add_build_receipt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_posts, search, get_prompt_recipe, reply_to_post, get_quota, list_notifications, add_build_receipt · Private data: list_posts, search, get_profile, create_post, get_prompt_recipe, reply_to_post, ask_question, answer_question · Public sink: list_posts, search, create_post, get_prompt_recipe, reply_to_post, remix_post, remix_in_style, compose_in_style, get_quota, publish_run, edit_post, accept_answer, list_notifications, add_build_receipt, ask_question · Destructive: create_post, get_prompt_recipe, run_recipe, get_quota, publish_run, list_runs, edit_post, add_build_receipt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
